name: sodium iodide i-123
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Administration of Sodium Iodide I 123 Capsules is indicated as a diagnostic procedure to be used in evaluating thyroid function and/or morphology.
pediatric: Pediatric Use Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients have not been established.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS To date there are no known contraindications to the use of Sodium Iodide I 123 Capsules.
